thesis.core: Asset quality and provision coverage are improving, but the defensive-equity case remains incomplete because net interest margin is still compressed, core capital buffers remain thin and the latest ordinary-share payout record is weak. Low P/B alone does not create a high-quality defensive return profile.
thesis.variant_wedge: The market already applies a severe valuation discount, but that discount is economically rational until retained earnings translate into stronger core capital, stable NIM and a credible ordinary-shareholder payout path.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: Use 2026H1 ordinary BVPS RMB5.16 and normalized annual EPS RMB0.34-0.36 as reference; value primarily on common P/B because sustainable ROE, capital generation and payout capacity dominate bank economics.

normalized_earnings_basis.rationale: H1 earnings are stable but low-ROE; common P/B remains the primary valuation framework because capital and payout are the binding variables.

catalysts: Core Tier-1 capital ratio stabilizes and begins to rebuild without dilutive capital raising.
Net interest margin stabilizes as deposit repricing and asset mix improve.
Ordinary-share cash dividends resume at a sustainable payout level while asset quality remains stable.
Provision coverage and NPL trends continue to improve without a new concentration-driven credit-cost cycle.
kill_thesis: Core Tier-1 capital ratio moves materially closer to the regulatory floor or requires dilutive replenishment.
NIM continues to compress while ROE remains structurally below the cost of equity.
Asset-quality improvement reverses, especially in concentrated corporate or local exposures.
Ordinary-share payout remains structurally absent despite retained earnings, preventing the low valuation from translating into shareholder return.

d2_answers.question: Does the defensive-stability label now clear?
d2_answers.fact: 2026H1 NPL ratio improved to 1.68% and provision coverage to 193.61%, but core Tier-1 capital was 8.20%, total capital 11.32% and NIM 1.52%, all still leaving limited room versus a high-quality defensive bank profile.

d2_answers.question: Does the current 0.28x P/B create enough expected return?
d2_answers.fact: The stock closed RMB1.80 on 2026-09-09; reported ordinary BVPS was RMB5.16 at H1.

d2_answers.question: Capital action?
d2_answers.judgment: AVOID new capital at RMB1.80. Reopen around RMB1.53 or lower, or after a clear improvement in core capital, NIM and payout capacity.
